title: Moderated operator/community submission flow (provenance + verification gate enforced)
context: The project explicitly prohibits unverified crowd submissions published without the provenance + freshness gate. However, a moderated submission flow — where operators or community members can propose a new listing or correction, which then enters the standard verification pipeline for human review — can expand coverage while maintaining quality. The gate must be enforced: no submission is published as authoritative without completing the same verification, license review, and PII review as an ingested entry. This task is backlog until M2 is stable.
objective: Implement a moderated operator/community submission flow that: (1) provides a simple submission form or structured issue template for operators or community members to propose new listings or corrections; (2) routes submissions to a moderation queue, not directly to the published dataset; (3) applies the same verification + provenance + license + PII gate as the standard pipeline before any submission is promoted to the authoritative dataset; (4) requires a human reviewer to approve each submission; and (5) notifies the submitter of the outcome.
acceptanceCriteria: Submission form or structured GitHub issue template captures: service name, address, hours, service type, contact, source URL (operator's own page or verifiable reference), and submitter contact (optional, not published)
Submissions enter a moderation queue (e.g. GitHub Issues with a 'pending-review' label) and are never auto-published to the authoritative dataset
A moderator review checklist covers: source verification, license check, PII review, geocode confirmation, and deduplication against existing entries
Submissions that pass the moderation checklist are merged via the standard PR + verification-log process (same gate as ingested entries)
Submissions that fail (unverifiable source, license issue, PII concern) are closed with a clear explanation to the submitter
No submitter personal data is retained beyond the submission review period or published in the dataset
The submission process is documented publicly (how to submit, what to expect, why verification is required)
output: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/submission.yml (structured submission template) + docs/submit.md (public submission guide) + moderation checklist in docs/moderation-checklist.md.
